hooks.command: MLLOG="$(pwd)/.venv/bin/mllog"; [ -f "$MLLOG" ] || MLLOG="$(pwd)/.venv/Scripts/mllog.exe"; [ -f "$MLLOG" ] || exit 0; INPUT=$(cat); PYEXE=$(dirname "$MLLOG")/python; [ -f "$PYEXE" ] || PYEXE=$(dirname "$MLLOG")/python.exe; [ -f "$PYEXE" ] || PYEXE=python3; SESSION=$(echo "$INPUT" | "$PYEXE" -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('transcriptPath') or d.get('transcript_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); ARGS=(capture --type analysis --status ok --auto); [ -n "$SESSION" ] && [ -f "$SESSION" ] && ARGS+=(--session-path "$SESSION"); "$MLLOG" "${ARGS[@]}" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
